Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
One participant in the game. Wraps the immutable identity (nickname + totem colour), the per-round picks counters (how many cards the player has drawn from the upper / lower rows for the offer tile they are currently resolving), and the mutable PlayerStats holding food, points and owned cards.

Both nickname and totem colour are uniqueness-checked by PlayersFilling when the player joins the lobby.
